items.title: Warren Vaché interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 23, 1995
items.q: the most exciting time of my life was Condon’s and being next to Gene

ctx.x: The next one. I think all in all for me the most exciting time of my life was Condon’s and being next to Gene. I mean thousands of people used to come hang at that bar. It was a party every night and most of the musicians that I heard about, read about, respected and many that I didn’t know came in and it was the time of my life where I actually met all of my heroes in a working capacity. It was a marvelous time. I didn’t know it at the time, but looking back on it now it was one hell of a good time.
Yeah. Tell us what a typical month for you is like now — a lot of traveling I would imagine, to get— I mean there’s probably not that many engagements right where you live.
